description: Create an editable QR code that redirects to `destination`. The response gives `shortUrl` (the URL to encode in the QR code; pass it to generate_qr_code to get the image) and `link` (the same code as a short link on qrkeep.me). The destination can be changed later, scans are counted, and the code keeps redirecting even if the plan ends. Needs QRLIFETIME_API_KEY.

design.description: Style object from the QRLifetime editor (colours, logo, frame). Omit to use your brand kit.

destination.description: http or https URL the code redirects to.

name: create_dynamic_qr_code
title: Create a dynamic QR code
